newsitem.title: USA: Alex. Brown 1996 investment banking revs up.
newsitem.headline: Alex. Brown 1996 investment banking revs up.

text.p: Alex. Brown Inc said Monday that investment banking revenues increased 41 percent in 1996 to a record $414.9 million.
The company said the increase was primarily due to a robust public offering underwriting market.
The company said fees from merger and advisory revenues increased 38 percent to $93.0 million.
The company said its commission revenues increased 16 percent to $201.9 million during the year, primarily due to increases in private client and institutional listed businesses.
Principal transaction revenues increased 20 percent to $167.8 million, due to increases in equity trading, which were partially offset by decreases in fixed income trading, the company said.
